Committed only the three scoped files on the wave branch; worktree left in place.

wave.summary: Built src/state/favorites.ts: a framework-agnostic favorites store against the frozen FAVORITES_KEY ('prompt-spark:favorites:v1') and Favorite union from src/core/types.ts. Exposes favId(f) (prompt.id for kind:'prompt', id for kind:'scout'), loadFavorites() (returns [] on missing key, invalid JSON, or non-array payload), addFavorite(f) (dedupes by favId, returns false as a no-op on duplicate), removeFavorite(id) (deletes exactly the first match via findIndex, false if absent), subscribe(fn) returning an unsubscribe fn, and useFavorites() built on React's useSyncExternalStore. Every write goes through a synchronous localStorage.setItem(FAVORITES_KEY, JSON.stringify(list)). Wrote src/state/favorites.test.ts (vitest, jsdom) covering: add appears in loadFavorites(); duplicate add returns false with length unchanged (for both prompt and scout kinds); remove deletes exactly one entry and a second remove returns false; a fresh loadFavorites() call after writes reconstructs the identical list (simulated reload); corrupt JSON and non-array JSON in the key both yield []; plus a directly-seeded duplicate-id case proving removeFavorite deletes only the first match. Note: the worktree's node_modules was missing (git worktrees don't carry gitignored dirs) so I symlinked it from the target repo to run tests/typecheck, then removed the symlink afterward — no package manifest or lockfile was touched, and the symlink was never staged/committed. tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit is clean for the src project; the repo-wide `tsc -b --noEmit` TS6310 error is pre-existing on the target repo itself (unrelated to this change) and was left untouched. A stray .tsbuild timestamp diff produced by running tsc was reverted before committing so the commit contains only the two in-scope files.

wave.summary:
Provisioned worktree at $WT and verified it derives from the target repo (git-common-dir + .swarm/SPEC.md present) before touching anything. Replaced the placeholder App.tsx with the real shell: top-level state {seed, filters, view}, a 3-button tab nav (Generator/Brain Scout/Favorites) with aria-pressed, rendered as a sticky bottom bar on narrow viewports and a top bar in a centered ~720px column at wide viewports. Built FilterBar.tsx with subject (4 + All) and difficulty (3 + Any) chips using the frozen .filter-chip/.filter-chip--active classes and conjunctive undefined-means-all semantics. Wrote compiling, typed stubs per spec: SurpriseHero.tsx (a .surprise-hero button wired to onSpark, which sets Math.floor(Math.random()*2**31) in App and shows the seed in a placeholder .prompt-card once tapped), PromptCard.tsx (typed props, renders null without a prompt), BrainScoutView.tsx (input + placeholder text + disabled 'Scout it' button + note), FavoritesView.tsx (empty-state div). Wrote src/styles/app.css: mobile-first single column at 375px with the hero button at min-height 30vh (largest element on screen), wrapping filter-chip rows, thumb-reachable tab bar, no horizontal scroll; centered ~720px column with generous spacing at wide viewports — built only on tokens.css custom properties/classes plus my own layout CSS. Imported app.css from App.tsx as instructed.

No package.json/lockfile/tokens.css/core files touched. The worktree had no node_modules (git worktrees don't inherit it and it's gitignored), so — without installing anything new or touching any manifest — I symlinked node_modules from the already-installed main repo into the worktree purely to run the test/type-check/build tooling that was already pre-installed; this symlink is untracked and was never staged or committed (git status confirms only it remains untracked after the commit).

Wrote src/ui/App.test.tsx covering every acceptance criterion: all three tabs render and navigate correctly (aria-pressed toggles, correct view content mounts/unmounts), the hero reveals the seed placeholder text on tap, and the filter chips apply conjunctive subject+difficulty semantics with 'All'/'Any' correctly reflecting the undefined state. No testing-library is in package.json, so tests use react-dom/client + React's act with raw DOM queries/dispatched click events instead. Ran npx vitest run (54/54 passing across 3 files), npx tsc -b (clean, no output), and npx vite build (succeeds, dist removed afterward since it's gitignored). Reverted a .tsbuild buildinfo side-effect from running tsc before committing, since that path is out of my file scope. Committed on wave-300400-T-009.
